dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Hello.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: It's nice and quiet here. Thank you for inviting me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: It's alright.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: I see that you opted for a diverse range of decorative styles.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Doesn't entirely suit my preferences, but that's fine with me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you have any suggestions?

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: It's hard to say.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: I value practicality. Aesthetics aren't generally something I put into consideration.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: But that's just my personal inclination. It may not work for you.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: After all, I'm not familiar with every single detail of your life.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: True.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: The top priority when furnishing a space is the owner's satisfaction.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Everything else is secondary.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to chat?

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Sure, if you're mentally prepared.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: But before you say anything — I'm not very interested in small talk. If you need something, just get to the point.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: As for whether I'll help, it'll depend on the situation.

choices.text: Is that mentality because of work?

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: You could say it's the product of life experience.

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: If you want to live at a more leisurely pace, you can try copying a page or two from my book.

choices.text: Is that something you learned through interacting with others?

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: Is it? I don't think I'd gain experience this valuable from standard social interactions.

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: But now, you've learned something by interacting with me. Congratulations.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything you want to do?

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: I already do what I want every day, so I can't think of a substantial answer to that question right away.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: I'm content with things as they are now.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You don't seem very busy most of the time.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Oh? Do I give you that kind of impression?

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Very well then. I don't like having my hands full — it interferes with my thinking process.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: But that reminds me... I need to make myself look like I'm always occupied, so I can avoid things I don't want to do and people I don't want to interact with.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: You, on the other hand, have a vast social circle, so you must run into difficult people quite often.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there a solution to that?

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: I suggest that you ask them a few questions that they'll never find exact answers to.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Once you divert their attention and energy into other matters, they should leave you alone rather quickly.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Thank you. That was very helpful.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Don't mention it.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: To some extent, I want everyone to lead the lives they want to live.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: That way, people will cause fewer headaches for each other.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That's a pretty unique way of thinking.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: I figure most people would think similarly.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Wouldn't it be great to live in a world without annoyances?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good morning, Alhaitham.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Good morning. It looks like you already have everything planned out for today.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Having things to do means you're being productive, while an empty schedule indicates a more leisurely day.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Both are fine choices. I wish you all the best.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good night, Alhaitham.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Good night.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: It's fine if you can't fall asleep. Tomorrow will come regardless.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Grilling meat looks easy, but it's actually difficult to do well.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Everything we need is here. You should give it a shot.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Who knows, maybe you'll become one of Teyvat's best pitmasters.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Books are meant to be read, but in many households, they often serve another purpose.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Decoration.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: What some lack is not intellect, but patience.
